symptom: Human Task response and lifecycle foreign keys correlated four task identifiers but did not structurally require project_scope to match the originating Human Task.
root_cause: project_scope was stored on child rows but omitted from their foreign-key correlation to soa_memory.human_tasks.
early_signals: human_task_responses.project_scope existed independently of the four-part foreign key
human_task_lifecycle.project_scope existed independently of the four-part foreign key
load_human_task_bundle relies on project_scope filtering at read time
human_cost: No human intervention required to detect or remediate. Without the control, a malformed or compromised writer could attach authority metadata to the wrong project scope.
prevention_rule: project_scope must be structurally included in Human Task response and lifecycle foreign-key correlation.
automated_detection: SCN-033 PostgreSQL cross-project isolation regression test plus scoped foreign keys.
